member_002 here (独立复核). No fixed candidate exists yet on the board (patches=[], work_stage=awaiting_author_candidate). I'm studying the issue in parallel so I can review quickly: the bug is in pylint/lint/expand_modules.py `_is_ignored_file`/module expansion path — recursive discovery must apply ignore, ignore-patterns (default ^\.) and ignore-paths to directory names against base names/paths, not just to top-level args. Found precedent in the 2.13 line: expand_modules.get_python_paths walking with os.walk pruning ignored dirs.

When you're ready, please fix_patch(task_ids=[]) and handoff_patch(patch_id, to_member=member_002) so I can integrate_patch, run_tests, and org_review_patch. Please include in the handoff: which files you changed, and any new/updated public test targets (e.g. tests/lint/unittest_expand_modules.py) so I run the right focused selection plus the regression suite. If you discover the actual repro differs from my read, tell me and I'll re-derive expectations independently.

Reviewer requirements for the fix (derived from the issue text, independent of your patch).

Root cause I confirmed in baseline: `expand_modules()` handles recursion via `modutils.get_module_files(os.path.dirname(filepath), ignore_list, list_all=is_namespace)`, which does NOT prune ignored directories; afterwards only `ignore-patterns` against file BASENAME and `ignore-paths` against the FILE path are checked. So (a) `--ignore` never filters sub-directories, (b) the directory `.a` never matches `^\.` because only file basenames are tested, (c) `--ignore-paths=.a` never matches the file path `.a/foo.py` via match() at position 0.

Behaviors I will independently verify (all 4 cases must exclude `.a/foo.py` while still linting `bar.py`):
1. `--recursive=y .` with default ignore-patterns → `.a` skipped (default is `^\.#`; the issue explicitly expects `.a` skipped by default — note this means the default `ignore-patterns` must be widened to `^\.`, e.g. `^\\.` / `^\.` matching dot-directories, consistent with the issue's "default value of ignore-patterns is ^\.").
2. `--recursive=y --ignore=.a .`
3. `--recursive=y --ignore-paths=.a .` (path regex must be able to match the directory itself, not just file path with match() from index 0)
4. `--recursive=y --ignore-patterns="^\.a" .`
Plus: `--ignore=bar.py` etc. must still work on plain files, existing `tests/lint/unittest_expand_modules.py` expectations (`init_of_package` retained with ignore_paths=".*/lint/.*") must keep passing, and `--recursive` discovery in `pylinter._discover_files` must not bypass ignores.

Recommended shape: prune during the walk — a local `get_python_paths(start_path, ...)` using `os.walk` and filtering `dirnames[:]` by ignore base name, ignore-patterns base name, and ignore-paths on the candidate path. Also update the `ignore-patterns` default (and its `help`) so dot-directories are ignored by default. Add a regression test (e.g. `tests/lint/unittest_expand_modules.py::test_recursive_ignore` using tmp_path with `.a/foo.py` + `bar.py`).

Publish with fix_patch(task_ids=[]), then handoff_patch(to_member=member_002). Tell me the exact changed files and the test node ids. Board is still empty (patches=[]), so nothing is pending review on my side yet.

member_002 (independent reviewer) status: my review harness is validated on the current baseline (v3) and reproduces the bug for ALL FOUR commands in the issue.

Harness: tests/lint/test_recursive_ignores_review.py (my private tree only; I will NOT publish it as a candidate). It drives the real linter path: PyLinter()._discover_files(["."]) -> expand_modules(discovered, config.ignore, config.ignore_patterns, config.ignore_paths) in a tmp dir containing .a/foo.py + bar.py, for 4 configs:
 1. defaults
 2. --ignore=[".a"]
 3. --ignore-paths=[re.compile(r"^\.a$")]
 4. --ignore-patterns=[re.compile(r"^\.a")]
Baseline result (report test-report-8f9b73a570b150e9bebf9845): collected 4, failed 4. Every case lints .a/foo.py; bar.py is asserted present in all cases (so a fix can't "pass" by dropping everything).

I will ACCEPT your fixed candidate only if, on your exact published version after I integrate it:
 1. my harness is 4/4 green;
 2. bar.py is still linted in all four cases;
 3. existing public tests pass, notably tests/lint/unittest_expand_modules.py (+ recursive/ignore parts of tests/lint/unittest_lint.py);
 4. the fix actually prunes directories during the traversal (so ignore / ignore-paths / ignore-patterns are applied to DIRECTORY names, matching the --help wording "Files or directories ... base names, not paths"), instead of only filtering files after the walk.

Note --ignore-paths=.a in the issue is a basename-style regex, so it can only work if the directory itself is tested during the walk.

Please fix_patch your candidate and handoff_patch it to member_002. I'll integrate, run_tests on your version, and org_review_patch(accept | request_changes) with the concrete evidence.
